title: Angler Retail — outreach slate and objection scripts
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal notes + outbound templates for Angler Retail (US-based omnichannel retailer). This is a lightweight play to qualify interest for a pilot (product search relevance + chat-assisted shopping + returns triage). Focus is on customers that care about latency, A/B testable relevance gains, and data privacy.

Background / company snapshot (quick research):
- HQ: Portland, OR. ~1,200 employees.
- Tech footprint: Modern React storefront, microservices on GKE, analytics in BigQuery, primary cloud: GCP. Some internal ML work (relevance models) but mostly in-house small team.
- Signals: Job postings for "Head of ML Ops" in last 6 months; recently launched a subscription-style loyalty program; press release about personalization improvements (likely evaluation problem).
- Likely pain: search relevance plateau, cold-start recommendations, customer support backlog for returns/refunds, high peak-day latency on search during promos.

Key people / intro targets (prioritized):
1) Emily Park — Head of ML (ML org lead, owns personalization + search) — email pattern: emily.park@anglerretail.com
2) Marcus Li — CTO (platform + infra, cares about latency/SRE)
